alsoKnownAs.name: Lemonade
alsoKnownAs.note: British usage; the fizzy kind, not the still squeezed drink.

generalSubstitutes.note: Plain soda water with the lemon dropped; far less sweet and no lemon flavour of its own.

forms.label: Standard
forms.sourceNote: Beverages, carbonated, lemon-lime soda, no caffeine. Public domain. Used as the generic figure for both British fizzy lemonade and Spanish gaseosa, which are the same style of drink — carbonated water, sugar and lemon flavouring — under different names. acidPercent left off: no titratable acidity source exists for this specific mixer.
